PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED:

2015-09-02 | 563 m MD | Girujan | stuck_pipe | medium | 2.1 hrs NPT
Cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Girujan, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stic
Remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 66 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 2.1 hrs.

2015-09-04 | 1269 m MD | Tipam | mud_loss | high | 5.6 hrs NPT
Cause: Total losses encountered in Tipam, no returns to surface for 5.6 hrs.
Remedy: Pumped cement plug to seal loss zone, waited on cement, tested integrity before resuming.

2015-09-04 | 1334 m MD | Tipam | mud_loss | low | 2.5 hrs NPT
Cause: Losses seen while running casing through Tipam, static losses continuing on connections.
Remedy: Spotted 39 bbl high-fluid-loss pill across the loss zone and monitored pit levels.

2015-09-07 | 2870 m MD | Barail | mud_loss | high | 12.5 hrs NPT
Cause: Losses seen while running casing through Barail, static losses continuing on connections.
Remedy: Spotted 94 bbl high-fluid-loss pill across the loss zone and monitored pit levels.

2015-09-07 | 2891 m MD | Barail | mud_loss | medium | 9.4 hrs NPT
Cause: Lost circulation 31 bbl/hr while drilling Barail sand, partial returns only.
Remedy: Pumped 66 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.

2015-09-08 | 3094 m MD | Kopili | kick | high | 8.3 hrs NPT
Cause: Flow-check positive, pit gain of 81 bbl and flow-out exceeding flow-in while in Kopili.
Remedy: Shut in well, closed BOP, circulated kill mud per driller's method.

2015-09-08 | 3418 m MD | Basement | torque_spike | low | 1.4 hrs NPT
Cause: Sharp torque increase on contact with Basement, ROP dropped to near zero.
Remedy: Reduced WOB and RPM, reamed interval, resumed drilling at reduced parameters.
